title: ANTI GRASS²
description: A challenge that cannot touch GREEN*
body:
A challenge where you must avoid touching anything green — 
stepping on green blocks or even attacking green entities will make you explode instantly💥!

Before starting the challenge, you can customize a variety of settings
to change your gameplay experience.

One of the most interesting additions is the special item “Turtao Helmet”,
a chaotic item that’s perfect for messing around with friends.
If you prefer a pure challenge run, you can simply disable this item.

Hope you enjoy this datapack — thank you for playing!



一個不能碰到綠色的挑戰，不管是踩方塊或是攻擊綠色實體都會使你自爆💥！

開始挑戰前，有許多設定可以調整
來改變你的遊戲體驗！

最有趣的是新增了特殊道具，「燙手龜殼」，在挑戰之餘還可以與朋友來場大亂鬥！
若是單純想挑戰通關也是可以關閉該道具。

希望你喜歡此資料包，謝謝！
